course_points.n: Turn right onto Nieuwe Hemweg and take S102 toward Rotterdam
Turn right onto Zijkanaal F West
Turn left onto Zijkanaal F Oost
Turn right onto Wethouder van Essenweg
At roundabout, take exit 2 onto Domineeslaan
Turn right onto Teding van Berkhoutweg
Turn slight right onto Wethouder Rijkeboerweg
Keep left onto Zijkanaal F Oost

points_of_interest.name: Docking Amsterdam (Minervahaven)
points_of_interest.description: Start/finish area at Minervahavenweg 17. Source: route start and existing route set.

points_of_interest.name: Bretten / western green corridor
points_of_interest.description: Route-geometry POI for the green westbound section leaving Amsterdam.

points_of_interest.name: SugarCity / Halfweg
points_of_interest.description: Former CSM sugar factory area in Halfweg, roughly halfway between Amsterdam and Haarlem. Source: https://www.sugarcity.com/

points_of_interest.name: Spaarnwoude / Houtrak scenic section
points_of_interest.description: Route-geometry POI for the open Spaarnwoude/Houtrak part of the loop.

points_of_interest.name: Grote Markt Haarlem
points_of_interest.description: Central market square in Haarlem; good review/stop point on the route. Source: https://tripomatic.com/en/poi/grote-markt-poi%3A25688249

points_of_interest.name: Molen De Adriaan
points_of_interest.description: Windmill museum on the Spaarne; about 400 m from the route line. Source: https://www.molenadriaan.nl/
